title: Durability Alert
description: Warns you in chat when your tools, weapons, or armor are about to break. Configurable thresholds, HUD display, sound alerts, and action bar support.
body:
# Durability Alert

Never accidentally break your favorite tools again. Durability Alert tracks the 
durability of your tools, weapons, and armor in real time — and warns you before 
it's too late.

## Features

### 🔔 Smart Warnings
Get notified the moment your item crosses a durability threshold. By default the 
mod alerts you at **50%, 25%, 10%, 5%, 1%**, and when only **1 durability** remains 
— but you can set your own thresholds in the config.

### 📍 Flexible Output
Choose where the warning appears:
- **Chat** — a styled message with the item name and remaining durability
- **Action Bar** — a quick heads-up above your hotbar without cluttering chat
- **Both** — why not

### 🛡️ Armor Tracking
Enable armor monitoring to get warned when your helmet, chestplate, leggings, 
or boots are wearing out. All four slots are tracked independently.

### 🖥️ HUD Display
Show live durability info above the hotbar. Fully customizable:
- **Item icon** next to the durability readout
- **Progress bar** with color that shifts from white → orange → red
- Multiple text formats: `125/251`, `125`, `125/251 (50%)`, `125 (50%)`
- **Offhand** item support
- **Armor row** with icons for all four slots
- Adjustable X/Y position

### 🔊 Sound Alerts
Plays a sound when a threshold is crossed. Choose from:
- Note Block Pling, Note Block Bell, Item Break, or Anvil Land
- Adjustable volume (0–100%)

### ⚙️ In-Game Config
All settings are accessible in-game via **Mod Menu** — no config file editing needed.

---

## Supported Versions
Pick the build that matches your Minecraft version — same features across all of them:

| Minecraft | Java | Notes |
|-----------|------|-------|
| **26.2**     | 25 | Latest |
| **26.1.x**   | 25 | |
| **1.21.1-1.21.11**   | 21 | |
| **1.20.1-1.20.6**   | 17 | |

> On 1.21.1-1.21.11 and 1.20.1-1.20.6, any breakable held item (tools, weapons, bows, fishing rods, 
> shears, etc.) is tracked in the hand, since those versions lack the newer item 
> data components.

## Requirements
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) — 0.19.3+ on 26.x, 0.15+ on 1.20.1-1.20.6 / 1.21.1-1.21.11
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) *(optional, for in-game config screen)*
